extract_captions_from_log_files: extract captions from log.txt files in a folder tree by walking subdirectories and reading a specified line index
run_coco_caption_evaluation: run COCO caption evaluation metrics including SPICE, CIDEr, and BLEU on extracted image captions against ground truth annotations
load_coco_results_from_json: load COCO caption results from a JSON file using pycocotools COCO.loadRes for evaluation
create_coco_eval_object: create a COCOEvalCap evaluation object from COCO ground truth and result datasets to compute captioning metrics
filter_captions_for_ablation: filter caption results to a 1000-image subset for ablation studies by matching image IDs against a directory listing
